newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah falls on regional volatility.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah falls on regional volatility.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fell to 2,464/68 against the dollar at 0130 GMT on Monday after regional currency volatility spilled over onto the rupiah, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said offshore attacks on the Malaysia ringgit and the Philippines peso seemed to have driven the rupiah into the turbulence.
"I think it's the spillover from the ringgit and the peso," the dealer said, adding that volume was not really large.
"There are only a few players out there because of the wide spread and high volatility," the dealer said.
She said six-month swap premiums jumped to 120/150 in the middle of uncertainty.

The central bank widened its intervention band to 12 percent from eight percent last Friday in a move which operators said was designed to pre-empt possible turbulence on the rupiah after speculators launched an attack on the regional currencies.
